description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Seeker of Skybreak to gain all creature types.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seeker of Skybreak ability, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2

uses.name: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion
